question: After Jesus said he saw him under the fig tree, what did Nathanael declare about Jesus?
options: You are Elijah who was to come
You are a great prophet from Galilee
You are the Son of God; you are the king of Israel
You are the son of Joseph from Nazareth
explanation: In John 1:49, Nathanael said, "Rabbi, you are the Son of God; you are the king of Israel."
